questions.q: The minimum number of satellites for a position solution:
questions.explain: Four unknowns: x, y, z and the clock error.
All satellites on one side of the sky means a large DOP.

questions.q: What is more accurate from a GPS receiver?
questions.explain: Doppler velocity: 0.05–0.2 m/s versus 1.5–3 m for position.

questions.q: Which u-blox dynamic model suits a drone?
questions.explain: The pedestrian/automotive models smooth and lag.
You need a dual-frequency receiver, a base and an RTCM stream.

questions.q: The main technique against multipath from the frame:
options: A higher antenna, a ground plane
Turn off GLONASS and keep GPS only
questions.explain: Reflections from the frame and the ground are the main source of jumps.

questions.q: What GPS rate is reasonable for a copter in ArduPilot?
options: 1 Hz — saves traffic and less load on the UART
50 Hz — the more often, the better
The rate doesn't matter to the EKF
questions.explain: 5–10 Hz is enough; the EKF gains nothing above that, while the UART and the receiver get loaded.

questions.q: Why is UBX better than NMEA for an autopilot?
options: Every ground station and radio understands it without setup
It's binary, more compact and has quality status
questions.explain: UBX is more compact and carries accuracy and status fields that NMEA lacks or has only partially.
